execution.controller_cpu_scope: pre-forward binding only, including executor begin/poll helpers; native worker dispatch and sampling excluded; end recorded by executor

executor.service_time_scope: compute-stream worker-forward interval including dependency waits and dispatch gaps; not exclusive CUDA kernels or HTTP latency

shared_path_timing.clock: perf_counter_ns; CPU wall intervals, not GPU kernel time
shared_path_timing.sampling: every Nth root call per phase, starting with the first; descendants inherit
shared_path_timing.scope: Measured completed samples only; exclusive values subtract measured children. No expansion to whole-run cost, exposed GPU idle or removable JCT.

opportunity_writer_timing.scope: Every 64th record per category, starting with its first record. Measured processing samples only; queue waiting and status publication are excluded. Wall includes scheduling and GIL waiting; thread CPU excludes waiting. No full-run cost, GPU stall, GIL attribution or JCT saving is inferred.
